playbook.name: OTE
playbook.description: Optimal Trade Entry — Fibonacci retracement into the 62–79% zone after a confirmed displacement.
playbook.entryRules: Enter at 62–79% Fib retracement from the swing low/high. Requires prior BOS or CHOCH.
playbook.slRules: SL below/above the swing low/high that created the OTE zone.
playbook.tpRules: TP1 at previous high/low (1:1 min). TP2 at premium/discount array above/below.

checklist.label: No major news in next 30 min

playbook.name: FVG / IFVG
playbook.description: Fair Value Gap — 3-candle imbalance. Enter on mitigation of the gap. IFVG = inverted/broken FVG used as support/resistance.
playbook.entryRules: Enter when price returns to fill the FVG (50% of gap minimum). IFVG: enter on retest of broken FVG from opposite side.
playbook.slRules: SL below the FVG (for longs) or above (for shorts).
playbook.tpRules: TP1 at next opposing FVG. TP2 at swing high/low.

playbook.name: Liquidity Sweep + Reversal
playbook.description: Equal highs/lows swept (stop hunt), then displacement reversal entry on retracement.
playbook.entryRules: Wait for EQH/EQL sweep. Confirm displacement candle opposite. Enter on OTE retracement of the displacement.
playbook.slRules: SL above the sweep high / below the sweep low.
playbook.tpRules: TP at opposing liquidity pool. Minimum 2:1 R:R.

checklist.label: HTF bias aligned with reversal direction
Clear equal highs or equal lows swept

playbook.name: Order Block Mitigation
playbook.description: Last opposing candle before a strong displacement move. Re-enter on retest of the OB body or wick.
playbook.entryRules: Mark the bullish/bearish OB (last down-candle before up-move, or last up-candle before down-move). Enter on retest of the body high/low.
playbook.slRules: SL below the OB low (long) / above the OB high (short).
playbook.tpRules: TP1 at displacement origin. TP2 at next liquidity pool.

checklist.label: OB has not been mitigated yet
Confluence: OB + FVG or OB + OTE

playbook.name: Breaker Block
playbook.description: Failed order block — once an OB is broken through and retested from the other side, it flips polarity (bullish breaker = old bearish OB).
playbook.entryRules: Identify a broken OB. Wait for retest from the new direction. Enter on rejection at the breaker.
playbook.slRules: SL beyond the breaker block extreme.
playbook.tpRules: TP at next liquidity pool / opposing breaker. 2:1 minimum.

playbook.name: Mitigation Block
playbook.description: Internal range OB used as a hidden support/resistance during pullbacks within trends. Often invisible without ICT framework.
playbook.entryRules: Within an established trend, mark the last counter-trend OB. Enter on first touch with rejection wick.
playbook.slRules: Tight SL beyond the mitigation block extreme — usually <0.5% on crypto majors.
playbook.tpRules: TP at trend continuation high/low. Trail to BE after 1R.

playbook.name: Turtle Soup (False Breakout)
playbook.description: Stop hunt above/below a previous high/low followed by immediate reversal. Classic liquidity grab.
playbook.entryRules: Wait for break of prior swing high/low. Re-enter when price closes back inside the range. Confirm with LTF BOS.
playbook.slRules: SL above the swept high / below swept low.
playbook.tpRules: TP at opposite extreme of the range. Often 3R+.

checklist.label: Clear prior swing high or low swept

playbook.name: Silver Bullet (15m window)
playbook.description: ICT 15-min window setup: 10–11 AM NY (and London 03:00–04:00 NY) — fade liquidity sweeps with FVG entries.
playbook.entryRules: Inside the 15-min window, look for a liquidity sweep + FVG creation. Enter on FVG retest.
playbook.slRules: SL above/below the sweep extreme. Tight risk.
playbook.tpRules: TP at next draw on liquidity. 2–4R typical.

checklist.label: Inside Silver Bullet window (10–11 AM NY)

playbook.name: Asian Range Breakout
playbook.description: Asian session range marked as liquidity. London/NY breakout takes the range edge then reverses or continues.
playbook.entryRules: Mark Asian high/low (00:00–06:00 UTC). On London open, wait for sweep of one extreme + LTF BOS, then enter retracement.
playbook.slRules: SL beyond the swept Asian extreme.
playbook.tpRules: TP at opposite Asian extreme (full range), then daily liquidity beyond.

checklist.label: Asian range clearly defined and tight

playbook.name: Previous Day High/Low Sweep
playbook.description: PDH/PDL act as magnets for liquidity. Sweep + reversal on the next session is a classic ICT play.
playbook.entryRules: Mark PDH and PDL. Wait for sweep during current session killzone. Enter on rejection candle close.
playbook.slRules: SL just beyond the swept high/low (usually 5–10 pips on crypto).
playbook.tpRules: TP at opposite PDH/PDL or weekly high/low.

playbook.name: Weekly Bias Continuation (Swing)
playbook.description: Swing trade aligned with the weekly bias. Enter on H4 OTE/FVG after a daily pullback.
playbook.entryRules: Determine weekly bias from W1 candle structure. On daily pullback, mark H4 OTE or FVG. Enter on H1 confirmation.
playbook.slRules: SL beyond the H4 swing low/high. Wider stops, smaller size.
playbook.tpRules: TP at weekly liquidity (prior weekly high/low). 5R+ targets.

checklist.label: No major weekly news event ahead

playbook.name: Rebalance / Equilibrium Trade
playbook.description: Price tends to return to the 50% of a previous range or impulse leg. Trade the bounce off equilibrium.
playbook.entryRules: Mark the recent impulse leg. Calculate 50% level. Enter on tap with rejection wick.
playbook.slRules: SL at 62% of the same leg.
playbook.tpRules: TP at full retracement back to impulse origin. Usually 1.5–3R.

playbook.name: Power of Three (AMD)
playbook.description: Accumulation → Manipulation → Distribution. Daily candle plays out as an Asian accumulation, London manipulation (sweep), NY distribution (run).
playbook.entryRules: After London sweeps Asian range, enter NY open in direction of HTF bias on confirmation.
playbook.slRules: SL beyond the London manipulation extreme.
playbook.tpRules: TP at NY session high/low or daily target. 3–5R typical.

playbook.name: Scalp: Market Structure Shift (LTF)
playbook.description: 1-min/5-min scalp on shift in market structure inside a killzone. Quick in, quick out.
playbook.entryRules: On 1m/5m, identify CHOCH then BOS in new direction. Enter on first FVG fill.
playbook.slRules: SL above/below the CHOCH high/low. Very tight.
playbook.tpRules: TP at next 5m liquidity pool. 1–2R, take profit aggressively.
